3. **Gradually Increase Distance**: Start by having your puppy sit in front of you. Gradually move away from them while they're still sitting. If they start to stand up, gently guide their bottom back down into a seated position.

4. **Consistency is Key**: Be consistent with your commands and rewards. Use the same words and gestures every time you want your puppy to sit.

5. **Practice Regularly**: Like any skill, training takes practice. Make it part of your daily routine to teach your puppy to sit.
